# ubuntu_kubeadm_worker Resource

Bootstraps a kubeadm worker node on an already-prepared Linux host.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "ubuntu_kubeadm_worker" "example" {
  target = var.host
  config_yaml = "example"
  name = "example"
}
```
## Argument Reference

The resource supports the following arguments:

- `allow_destructive_destroy` (Optional, Computed, bool) - Explicitly allow destroy to run kubeadm reset -f on the node.
- `config_yaml` (Required, string) - Opaque kubeadm JoinConfiguration YAML.
- `name` (Required, string) - Logical name for this kubeadm worker node resource.
- `port` (Optional, int64) - Target port for this resource. Overrides provider default_target.port.
- `target` (Optional, string) - Target host or address for this resource. Overrides provider default_target.target.
- `transport` (Optional, string) - Transport for this resource. The current provider surface supports ssh.

## Attribute Reference

This resource exports the following attributes:

- `id` (string) - Stable kubeadm worker resource identifier.
- `joined` (bool) - Whether the host appears joined to a kubeadm cluster.
- `kubelet_config_path` (string) - Path to the kubelet kubeconfig on the node.
- `node_name` (string) - Detected Kubernetes node name on the host.
